n, k = map(int, input().split())
digits = []
while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % k)
    n //= k
length = len(digits)
MOD = 1000000007

# Initialize transition matrix
transition = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
for j in range(k + 1):
    transition[0][j] = 1
    transition[j][j] = 1

# Precompute matrices
matrices = [transition]
for i in range(1, length):
    prev = matrices[i - 1]
    newMat = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for x in range(k + 1):
        for y in range(k + 1):
            for z in range(k + 1):
                newMat[x][z] = (newMat[x][z] + prev[x][y] * transition[y][z]) % MOD
    matrices.append(newMat)

total = 1
offset = 0
for i in range(length - 1, -1, -1):
    for j in range(digits[i]):
        for x in range(k + 1):
            total = (total * matrices[i][(x + offset) % k][k]) % MOD
        offset = (offset + j) % k

print(total % MOD)
